entries.title: National Rankings: filter by club or region
items: The Club and Region column headers now have a funnel icon that opens a filter — pick a club or a region (or both) to narrow the table instantly. Exports include the filtered rows, and the filter clears itself when you change year, step or discipline.

entries.title: National Rankings: STEP 1–4 qualifying indicator
items: STEP 1–4 now show a 'Q' column on the right of the table — a check means the gymnast has met the Gymnastics NZ qualifying score of 52.000 twice in the season (two different competitions), a dash means they haven't. Hovering the Q header shows what it means.

entries.title: National Rankings: table tidy-up
items: The Total column has been removed (the bolded Average remains), and the table shows two score columns for most steps and three for STEP 5/6.
The 'Enable Region Quotas' and 'Exclude non-qualifiers' toggles now have info tooltips explaining them, and both toggles are hidden for STEP 1–4 and MAG Level 1–3 where they don't apply.
When 'Exclude non-qualifiers' is on, a note appears below the table reminding you that the filter is hiding gymnasts who haven't reached the qualifying mark.
Score tooltips no longer get clipped at the right edge of the table.

entries.title: STEP 5/6 national rankings use the average of the top 3 scores
items: STEP 5 and STEP 6 rankings are now ordered by the average of each gymnast's three best competition scores (three score columns are shown). All other steps keep using the top two scores.

entries.title: Events page: host clubs shown in their region's colours
items: The Host Club column on the Events page now displays each host club in its region's colours (matching the region badges on the National Rankings), with long club names truncated.

entries.title: National Rankings: one mark per competition and corrected GNZ qualifying marks
items: Each gymnast now contributes only their highest mark from each competition, so a two-day meet (All Around + Apparatus Finals) can't fill both ranking slots.

The 'Exclude non-qualifiers' filter now uses the Gymnastics NZ qualifying rules: STEP 5/6 need two marks at 50.000 (one outside their home province), STEP 7–10 need two marks at 43.000 from different competitions, FIG Youth/Junior/Senior International need one mark at 42.500/43.000/45.000, and MAG Level 7–9, U18 and Senior Open need one mark at 63.000.

Events now have a Host Club that drives the STEP 5/6 'outside home province' rule (the club's region is used). It's guessed on upload and editable on the Events page; existing events can be filled in without re-uploading via 'python -m app.backfill_host_club' (dry-run first).

entries.title: What's new is now for logged-in users
items: The 'What's new' section on the homepage is now only shown to logged-in users.

entries.title: Wellington apparatus specialists: mark needed twice at different competitions
items: STEP 8–10 apparatus specialists now need to reach the qualifying mark (11.000) twice at different competitions on the same apparatus, instead of once on two different apparatus.

Athletes who have reached the mark only once so far on an apparatus get a greyed-out outline badge for that apparatus — alongside any solid badges for apparatus where the mark was reached twice or more. The ghost badge's tooltip notes the competition where the mark was reached and that a second competition is still needed.

entries.title: Rankings pages redirect signed-out visitors to the homepage
items: Visiting the National Rankings or Wellington Rankings pages without being logged in now redirects to the homepage instead of showing a load error. Members who don't have access to a particular ranking page are redirected too — for example, a member with National access only can't open the Wellington Rankings page.

entries.title: Admin pages redirect signed-out visitors to the homepage
items: Visiting /admin or /admin/users without being logged in now redirects to the homepage instead of showing an error-filled page. The redirect waits until the auth check resolves, so the admin UI never flashes.

entries.title: Login button now shows on every page
items: The site is now marked as in beta — the homepage shows an alert noting that results are provided as-is and may contain errors or inaccuracies, and the nav logo carries a small Beta badge.
Added a footer contact: found a bug? Email myles@hcg.org.nz.

entries.title: Login button now shows on every page
items: Fixed a bug where the Login button (and mobile menu's Login link) only appeared on the upload page — the auth-configured check was never run on other pages. It now appears in the nav across the site, including the homepage for signed-out visitors.

entries.title: Per-user page access for rankings
items: Admins can now grant or revoke access to each ranking page per user from the User Management page (National Rankings and Wellington Rankings checkboxes).
New members are granted National Rankings by default; Wellington Rankings access must be explicitly granted.
Users without access to a ranking page no longer see it in the nav menu, and visiting the page directly shows a "No access" message. Admins always have full access.

entries.title: Export buttons restyled
items: Export menus on all results and ranking tables now use the secondary theme colour and sit flush against the right edge of the toolbar.

entries.title: Wellington Rankings — presentation polish
items: Apparatus Specialists now appear above the "Not on the Ranking" table.
Team indicators are circles instead of badges, and the second-team (2) markers were removed for STEP 7+ levels — only the top-4 markers remain.
The step dropdown now lists STEP 5–10 then Youth, Junior, Senior in that order.

entries.title: International divisions on the Wellington Rankings
items: WAG Youth/Junior/Senior International levels now appear in the Wellington rankings step selector, ranked by a gymnast's single highest All Around mark.
Gymnastics NZ qualifying marks on one occasion: Youth 42.500, Junior 43.000, Senior 45.000.

Junior and Senior International athletes can also qualify as apparatus specialists by reaching the mark on one apparatus (Junior: VT 12.200 / UB 10.400 / BB 10.500 / FX 11.400; Senior: VT 12.500 / UB 11.300 / BB 11.200 / FX 11.400) — vault is the average of two.
MAG Level 7+ now also lists apparatus specialists who reach 11.500 on one apparatus.

entries.title: Wellington Rankings — combined "Not on the Ranking" table
items: The separate "In Progress" and "Not on the Ranking" tables are merged into one, listed alphabetically: every Wellington athlete who isn't on the ranking.

Each row's tooltip shows a check/cross requirements checklist — regional, named and away events, intent, and the GNZ/Wellington qualifying marks — each showing what's achieved and what's still missing (e.g. "2 away competitions (1 of 2)").

The ranking now always shows only qualified and intended athletes (the GNZ/Wellington/Intent filter toggles are gone); everyone else appears below, and ticking an athlete's Intent moves them up immediately.

Score columns in the lower table now align with their category slots (Regional Best / Next Best / Away Best) — each event appears in the right column, with a dash where an athlete has no event for that slot.

entries.title: Accessibility pass — all pages 100/100 on Lighthouse
items: Keyboard access everywhere: mobile menu, file upload, table sorting and filters, score/competition tooltips, the NZ region map, and every dialog.
Dialogs now trap focus, close on Escape, and restore focus to the button that opened them.
Screen-reader labels added to all inputs, selects, icon-only buttons, toasts, and error messages; navigation announces the current page.
Reduced-motion preference is respected by the landing-page animations.
Contrast fixes across light and dark themes, including the club region badges and the map focus indicator.

entries.title: Home, clubs & NZ map polish
items: Landing page: the three info items (WAG & MAG, Export & Share, Smart Filtering) moved above the clickable nav cards and stripped of card styling, so the links clearly read as links.
Wellington Rankings: removed the coloured top border on the qualification-protocol card.
NZ map: hovering or selecting a region sets its checker pattern scrolling diagonally — each region has its own direction and speed.
Clubs page on mobile: the map is replaced by a collapsible accordion of the region cards (tap to expand), listed north to south.

entries.title: Gymnast browsing upgrades
items: Gymnasts page: sticky header with the search box and alphabet jump bar inline, so both stay visible while scrolling.
The alphabet bar highlights the section you're currently viewing, and a 'Back to top' button appears once you scroll.
Home-page stat badges and Wellington apparatus-specialist badges now use the default text style (no monospace).
Events list: the 'Nationals' badge now sits next to the event name in accent styling instead of the Discipline column.

entries.title: Full update history on the landing page
items: 'What's new' now shows the entire patch-note history in a scrollable section instead of only the latest few entries.

entries.title: Export to CSV, XLSX & PDF
items: One dropdown on every results and rankings page — download CSV, Excel, or a printable PDF.
XLSX keeps full per-pass detail with tidy column widths; PDF mirrors the on-screen table with a header and page numbers.

entries.title: Interactive NZ map for clubs
items: Explore clubs on a clickable map of 15 gymnastics regions with theme colours and smooth panel transitions.
Provincial teams sit next to their region header, separate from regular clubs.

entries.title: Smarter uploads from URLs
items: Paste a Scoreholder event link to import it directly — no need to download and upload the JSON file.
Unknown clubs are flagged with suggested mappings (exact + fuzzy matches) you can accept or keep as-is.

entries.title: Landing page remix
items: Live stat counts now sit as badges on each nav card; the separate stats row is gone.
Added a 'What's new' section fed from patch notes, with a subtle on-load reveal that respects reduced-motion.

entries.title: Wellington rankings: intent tracking & team badges
items: Admins can mark which gymnasts intend to compete at Wellington events; a filter shows only those athletes.
Top-4 (1st Team) and 5–8 (2nd Team) badges highlight the strongest WAG STEP 7+ athletes.
Qualifier warning tooltips explain why an athlete did or didn't qualify.
Apparatus specialists (WAG STEP 8–10) who hit the qualifying mark on two apparatus now appear with colour-coded badges and competition tooltips.

entries.title: Inline editing in results tables
items: Admins can fix a gymnast's name, GNZ ID, or club right in the results table with a per-row save.

entries.title: WAG STEP 7–10 qualification tightened
items: Now requires two GNZ-qualifying scores from different competitions (was a single score).
MAG Level 7+ Wellington qualifying threshold set to 63.0.

entries.title: Admin cache refresh
items: New Refresh Cache button on the admin dashboard instantly clears the backend cache after uploads or edits.
Ranking endpoints no longer browser-cached so intent and qualifier toggles reflect immediately.

entries.title: Wellington regional rankings
items: Regional rankings for WAG STEP 5–6 and 7–10 with GNZ + Wellington dual-qualifier filters.
Distinct-event enforcement, per-step-range selection rules, and a dedicated rankings page with WAG/MAG tabs.

entries.title: Faster pages
items: Backend caching refactored with per-key TTLs and per-event invalidation; database indexes and SQLite PRAGMA tuning.
Optimised HTTP Cache-Control headers (public + stale-while-revalidate on reads, no-store on writes).
Pagination and debounced search in the results table.

entries.title: Browsing polish
items: Gymnasts page gains letter-jump navigation, live search, and tidier name/ID/club layout.
Visual hierarchy improvements, new scoreboard logo/favicon, and regional colour differentiation.

entries.title: National season rankings
items: Season rankings per discipline and STEP: best 2 competitions per gymnast (Nationals excluded), summed total, ties marked 'T'.
Region quota and qualifier filters let you focus on qualifying marks.
Gymnasts with only partial apparatus passes get a computed All-Around aggregate.

entries.title: Nationals flag on events
items: Admins can mark an event as a Nationals competition, which excludes it from season rankings.

entries.title: Athlete ID reconciliation & duplicate resolution
items: Admin dashboard groups athletes by name with per-instance GNZ ID dropdowns and confidence-based auto-fix.
Suggested merges detect similar names (e.g. nicknames/spelling variants) with one-click merge.

entries.title: Region badges & colours
items: Each of the 15 gymnastics regions gets its own NZ-sports-inspired colour palette and a checkerboard badge.
Region column added to wide results tables (enriched from club lookup, filterable).

entries.title: Cleaner names & production deployment
items: Automatic name cleanup at import: diacritics normalised, trailing (L#) / (STEP 10) / (YI) suffixes stripped, metadata removed.
Production Docker Compose with multi-stage frontend build and /api proxying through the frontend server.

entries.title: Accounts & role-based access
items: Username + password login with JWT tokens and admin/member roles.
Admin user management (create accounts, reset passwords, delete).
Upload, Admin, and Rankings links are gated by role.
Global year selector in the nav bar applied across all data pages.

entries.title: Club mapping on upload
items: When a file references a club we don't recognise, a dialog lets you map it to a known club or keep the original name.
Round-type parsing fixed: 'Qualification' suffix stripped, Day 2 classified correctly, individual scores skipped in All-around PRTs.

entries.title: Multi-file upload & faster results
items: Drag-and-drop supports multiple files with a per-file status queue.
In-memory cache for wide pivots plus Cache-Control/ETag headers on read endpoints.
CSV/XLSX exports include per-pass vault and bonus columns.

entries.title: Division & round fixes
items: Division falls back to the unit name when the level is missing; GfA levels filtered out.
Day 2 round-type collision fixed; discipline derived from apparatus in competition node trees.

entries.title: Gymnast & club browsing
items: New gymnasts list page (searchable, grouped A–Z) and clubs list page grouped by region.
Year selectors on gymnast and club result pages; stats cards link through to events, results, and clubs.

entries.title: Upload, events, and protected writes
items: Landing page redesigned; upload moved to its own page.
Event search, sortable columns, delete, and rename.
Password-based auth with a login page protecting write routes.
Filtered CSV export on the event detail page (exports only the currently filtered rows).

entries.title: Wide results, tooltips, and export expansion
items: Tailwind + DaisyUI restyle with dark theme and a sticky nav.
Per-apparatus score tooltips (D/E/N/bonus/rank) and an All-Around tooltip.
Per-pass vault columns with level-aware aggregation (STEP 6/7 average, high-level best/avg).
WAG/MAG tabs split results by discipline; DNS/DNF handled; bonus propagated across passes.
All-results view across every event.

entries.title: NZ Gymnastics Results launches
items: Backend parses Scoreholder JSON exports into a normalised SQLite database.
FastAPI endpoints for upload, events, results, and CSV/XLSX export.
SvelteKit frontend with a drag-and-drop upload page and events/results browsing.
Docker Compose for easy local development.
